model_annotation: Figure 3(a) presents a line chart illustrating the F1 score as a function of the label missing ratio for three different frameworks: Teacher (red line with circle markers), Self-Training (blue line with triangle markers), and PST (green line with square markers). The x-axis, labeled "标签缺失比例" (Label Missing Ratio), is linearly scaled from 0.0 to 0.585, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "F1" (F1 score), is linearly scaled from 52.5 to 72.5, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The chart displays three distinct lines, each representing one framework. The Teacher framework begins at an F1 score of approximately 72.5 when the label missing ratio is 0.0 and decreases to approximately 62.5 at a ratio of 0.585. The Self-Training framework starts at an F1 score of approximately 70.0 and decreases to approximately 55.0. The PST framework begins at an F1 score of approximately 70.0 and decreases to approximately 65.0. All three lines show a general downward trend as the label missing ratio increases.
